To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Ty 1/T3 is a new class of resistance genes, which is allelic and codes for an atypical RDRg class of RNA dependent RNA polymerases, which is involved in amplifying the RNAi response.
we have fine mapped two tomato genes, Ty 1 and T 3, which confer resistance against TYLCV and are allelic.
we have fine mapped two widely used resistance genes against TYLCV and that we have shown that they are allelic and code for a RDRg type RNA dependent RNA polymerases.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of a new class of resistance genes, the DFDGD type RDRg class.
the identification of the resistance genes, the fine mapping of their genomic location and the identification of their molecular function.
the identification of the resistance gene and the resistance mechanism of the widely used Solanaum chilense resistance genes Ty 1 and T3 against TYLCV.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Ty 1/T3 encodes an RNA dependent RNA polymerize that is involved in the amplification and systemic spreading of a viral RNA silencing signal, and is therefore a resistance gene.
the Ty 1 and the Ty 3 genes are allelic, code for an RDRg type RDR, and that the RDRg class is involved in the amplification and/or silencing of viral RNAs.
the RDRg class of genes, represented by Ty 1/TY 3, is the first RDR gene to be identified as a resistance gene against viruses and that it is involved in the resistance of plants to begomoviruses.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Ty 1 and 3 genes code for a new class of RDRs and that they confer resistance to TYLCV by an RNA silencing mechanism.
the Ty 1 and 3 genes are allelic and code for an RDRg class RNA dependent RNA polymerases.

we have identified the gene for the resistance to TYLCV, which is the most destructive disease for tomato production worldwide, and that the gene belongs to a completely new class, which may be important for the future of plant disease resistance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Ty 1 and the Ty 3 gene are allelic and code for the first DFDGD class RNA dependent RNA polymerases (RDRs) to be described.
the RDRg gene family has a function in the resistance to TYLCV and that this function is different from that of the RDRa family.
the RDRg class may be a new type of resistance gene that can be exploited for resistance to other geminivirus species.
